definitions.title: Actual reference
definitions.formula: unchanged frozen production mask and material

definitions.title: Constant sleeve
definitions.limitations: existing lower width bound; diagnostic control only

definitions.title: Selected / chemical contour
definitions.limitations: authored linear map, not measured material spreading

definitions.title: Alternatives / chemical contour
definitions.historyRole: retain supported alternative connections; chemistry sets contour
definitions.limitations: terminal hull is an explanatory graph, not proven independent load paths

definitions.title: Alternatives / mechanical contour
definitions.historyRole: local contact compaction shapes transverse contour
definitions.limitations: no levee assumption; fixed raw0–1 scale may have little geometric effect

definitions.title: Reconnection pockets
definitions.formula: R union bounded4-complement pockets of T
definitions.historyRole: chemistry shapes web; closed connection pockets span an interior
definitions.limitations: spanning is a new authored interpretation; compare8-complement before treating faces as physical

definitions.title: Character-only comparator
definitions.input: mean B and production support D
definitions.formula: K mask; existing coefficient mapping over K
definitions.historyRole: history changes whole-Plate coefficients, not membership or width
definitions.limitations: no local thickness/stiffness map; no sound or perceptual result

definitions.title: Alternatives / constant sleeve
definitions.historyRole: withhold history to test how much dense scaffold already fills
definitions.limitations: diagnostic floor-dominance control, not a new body family

definitions.title: Constructive chemical sections
definitions.formula: union discs centered at i in I, radius .012+.018*B(i)
definitions.historyRole: each structural sample carries its local chemical cross-section
definitions.limitations: authored bounded radial growth; no measured material transport or physical field law

definitions.title: Uniform mean sections
definitions.historyRole: retain mean widening while removing local radius variation
definitions.limitations: preserves mean radius, not exact raster area or edge curvature; diagnostic only
